message.content: In the conversation, ThaneChambers suggests doing a group purchase of the new games. Specifically, ThaneChambers invites LiHua to go shopping for games together this weekend, mentioning that there are some killer discounts at the local game store. He proposes meeting up at noon on Saturday, suggesting they can also grab lunch afterward. LiHua agrees to meet him at that time, indicating that ThaneChambers' suggestion was well-received and that they are looking forward to their planned outing.
